But what I didn’t expect was to run into the student council president here. And to make matters worse, he played with me so much that my legs went weak.

90514.synopsis:
Chef Qin Xia, while on vacation, met with an unfortunate accident and transmigrated into a novel.
He became the cannon fodder character who forcibly married the antagonist while the latter was injured and amnesiac-only to eventually meet his end at the villain’s hands.
The “husband” that the original character had bought from a broker was none other than Yu Jiuque, the future Head of the Directorate of Ceremonial and Eastern Palace (Embroidered Uniform Guard, jinyiwei’s department), who would one day wield immense power over the empire.
With a beautiful face but a venomous heart, Yu Jiuque was infamous for his ruthlessness.
When Qin Xia arrived in this world, the original character had already dragged the antagonist into bed, intending to consummate their marriage. Feeling the chill on his neck, Qin Xia stiffly changed the subject: 
“Are you hungry? How about I make you some noodles?”
Yu Jiuque then proceeded to eat all the noodles-five bowls in total-and declared himself to be Qin Xia’s husband, wholeheartedly devoted to warming his bed.
Since there was no way to get rid of this “great Buddha,” Qin Xia had no choice but to go out and make money before they both ended up in poverty.
The neighbors soon noticed that the local street thug, Qin Xia, had turned over a new leaf after getting married, even setting up a food stall. At first, no one believed that his food would be any good-until they tasted his iron plate tofu, grilled cold noodles, starch sausages, spicy sour noodles, grilled chicken racks, Chinese pancakes, thumb-sized dumplings, egg burgers, and steamed rice cakes…
Qin Xia’s food stall became a hit!
Before long, the food stall turned into a proper restaurant, and people realized that Qin Xia could do more than just street food.
A honey-glazed ham, glistening and tender, sweet and soft; a pot of braised eel, tender and flavorful, perfect with rice; “Three Crisps” from the mountains, beautiful and bursting with the freshness of spring in every bite; “Wensi Tofu,” shredded as fine as hair, left everyone in awe.
The restaurant was bustling every day, bringing in a fortune.
But one day, Jiu Ge’er suddenly disappeared from Qin Xia’s side. Everyone speculated that, as they say, “men get rich and then go bad,” thinking that Qin Xia must have abandoned him to marry a wealthy wife.
Months later, in the distant imperial capital, the most feared man in the court, Yu Jiuque, suddenly sneezed. He placed his hand on his slightly rounded belly, his face darkening with displeasure.
Under his formidable gaze, the ministers in the hall fell silent, trembling like leaves.
— Lord Yu’s thunderous wrath. Today, someone would likely lose their head!
But after a long pause, they only heard Yu Jiuque’s icy voice: “If you have something to report, speak quickly. If not, get lost and don’t delay me from going home for dinner.”
Author’s note: The original plot is just a backdrop, and the story mainly revolves around food and business management. The romance is sweet and slow-burning, light-hearted, and warm, with no problematic relatives. There will be children and family-building later on.

95890.synopsis:
Author: Why did you become a urologist?
Gong: To treat my old classmate’s illness.
Author: Did you cure him?
Gong: Tch, he ran away.
A story of a doctor Gong x CEO Shou.

96402.synopsis:
“The sweetest trap awaited me beyond betrayal.”
Betrayed by my childhood friend, my broken heart was saved by a golden-haired beauty, Maria. Every time I experienced her kindness, my destiny began to shift. A bittersweet, unpredictable journey of love unfolds, where betrayal, desire, and newfound affection intertwine.
associated_names: 神に捨てられた僕は、女神に堕とされる

97682.synopsis:
System 414 hit rock bottom in performance rankings yet again. This time, the higher-ups couldn’t even be bothered to assign him a host.
414: No host? Fine! This system will take the stage and change the fate of the people in these small worlds on my own!
The dream was beautiful, but reality was harsh—after all, systems lack emotional intelligence.
Taking the place of the host, the system Si Yisi knew nothing about human relationships. Whenever faced with troublemakers, his first instinct was to tear them apart!
***
What’s the task? What’s the plot?
Make him get beaten up? Make him freeze in the cold? Make him be hunted down?
Si Yisi delivered a slap, sending the incessantly chattering troublemaker crashing into the wall.
A perfect human-shaped imprint appeared.
Suddenly, silence filled the room.
***
The system will teach you how to be human—
If you don’t like it, tough!
After personally taking on missions, the system realized they were just a tiny bit challenging. But that didn’t stop him from constantly disdaining the hosts.
associated_names: The System Teaches You How to Be a Good Person

98450.synopsis:
[Criminal Investigation + Crime + Invincible + All-Powerful + Hardcore Case Solving] 
A killer who can create the perfect crime must also be the strongest ace detective.
Su Ming, who had just passed the police academy entrance exam, unexpectedly gained the ability to simulate crimes in his dreams.
Each time he simulated the perfect crime and no one discovered the mu*derer during the statute of limitations, he would gain various skills used in the crime.
After simulating the perfect crime 100,000 times, he acquired countless skills.
Su Ming, who should have become the number one criminal, instead joined the criminal investigation team after graduation.
To him, all cases seemed like child’s play, full of mistakes. Even the smallest detail or loophole could directly point to the criminal!
As he continued to solve what others considered perfect crimes and long-unsolved cases, the whole country began to call Su Ming the true ace detective.
Unable to wear even the first-class merit medal, his police rank soared five levels in a short time.
Become a criminal? Impossible!
It’s far easier to become a criminal investigator, solve cases, and achieve fame and success!
associated_names: 模拟犯罪十万次，我竟成王牌神探

100754.synopsis:
“It used to be soft and squishy, which was nice…”
“……”
“Why did you lose so much weight? Hyung is disappointed.”
His drowsy, languid voice tickled the nape of my neck. Along with that, the warmth of his body against my back made my heart flutter. His words, spoken so tenderly, stirred something inside me while simultaneously sending a chill through my solar plexus. There’s no way it could be good. Something like a wobbling mass of flesh, a sight so repulsive just to look at, couldn’t possibly be good.
Ha-min’s face noticeably fell at the playful, yet excessive comment. His slight, nervous movements came to a stop, as if he didn’t know what to do.
“……”
Sensing this, Tae-rim slowly opened his eyes. Beyond his previously closed vision, he could see Ha-min’s profile, quietly staring into space. It was a rare expression for Ha-min. Deeply sunken. Tae-rim, feeling something was off, furrowed his brow and once again tightly hugged Ha-min’s waist.
Soon after, Ha-min’s tightly closed lips parted. His voice was quiet, almost crawling.
“Because it doesn’t look good…”
“…?”
“When you’re fat, you smell… it’s dirty, so…”
The last syllable trembled slightly. His voice, muttering as if self-harming, and his bitter tone were unnaturally dark.
Clearly sensing something was wrong, Tae-rim tickled the back of Ha-min’s neck with the tip of his nose, like a puppy. With a rustle, Ha-min’s hair touched Tae-rim’s nose bridge, and he could feel Tae-rim’s skin nuzzling against him.
“Don’t say such foolish things…”
He whispered in Ha-min’s ear, comforting him.
“Hyung likes everything about you.”
Affectionately.
“Even the smell of grass and milk that comes from you.”
Sweetly.
“…Ever since we were young.”
With such unfair words.

101010.synopsis:
After the downfall of her maternal family left her without support, Wen Zhuojin, the daughter of the former matriarch of Jing’an Marquis Mansion, had her engagement to the heir of Rongguo Duke Mansion snatched by her stepsister.
Following the broken engagement, rumors spread that the heartbroken Wen Zhuojin, who was said to be crying day and night at home, actually disguised herself and went to a pleasure house in the western district of Yunjing City. There, she redeemed a pure courtesan, housed her in a separately purchased residence, and treated her like a priceless treasure.
The world believed that the engagement had been stolen from Wen Zhuojin, but in fact, it was a marriage she had long wanted to call off.
Because Wen Zhuojin did not like men, she only loved women, especially those who were older than her and stunningly beautiful.
The beauty she brought back perfectly matched her criteria.
To support this beauty, Wen Zhuojin worked hard in business to earn money, providing her with food, clothing, and luxuries more extravagant than those of the nobles in the palace.
However, she felt guilty toward the beauty for being unable to openly give her a proper status.
When Wen Zhuojin entered the palace to seek an audience with a noble and tried to use a large sum of money to request a title for her beauty, she caught sight of the current Grand Princess.
The Grand Princess wore a hibiscus crown and mysterious black Daoist robes, holding a whisk. Her aura was like an ice-capped snowy mountain—noble, cold, and ethereal, untouched by mortal affairs.
Rumors said that at fifteen, the Grand Princess had helped her young brother ascend the throne, quelled rebellions, subdued neighboring countries, and ruled with decisive killing intent. Her power was overwhelming, and everyone feared her.
She was also the woman Wen Zhuojin feared the most.
While everyone else knelt and paid respects, Wen Zhuojin stared at the Grand Princess with pupils trembling in shock, shivering uncontrollably.
Who could tell her why the Grand Princess looked exactly like her delicate, helpless beauty sister!!!
At twenty, Grand Princess Yan Qinglan became a Daoist priestess and swore never to marry. Yet, unexpectedly at twenty-six, she was poisoned and lost her sight. A girl with a sweet, clear voice softly coaxed her and took her away.
At that time, Yan Qinglan was in a dire situation. When she drew near the girl, the faint fragrance on her body eased the pain of the poison’s onset. So, she went along with it, following the girl back to see what her intentions were.
The girl did indeed have intentions on Yan Qinglan, but they were completely different from what Yan Qinglan had imagined.
Delicacies and fine jade dishes, brocade clothes and luxurious attire—she was pampered to the utmost extravagance. In just a few days, Yan Qinglan was nurtured to become even softer and more tender, exquisitely beautiful beyond words.
And all the girl sought was a kiss on the lips.
“Sister, kiss me.”
“Sister, hug me.”
“Sister, cuddle me.”
The sweet voice, laced with coquettish tones, lingered obsessively in her ears day after day.
Gradually, Yan Qinglan developed a greedy attachment. Even after her eyes healed, she continued playing the role of the girl’s “outer mistress” while stirring up storms in the court, vying for power and influence.
Wen Zhuojin confirmed that the Grand Princess Yan Qinglan and her beautiful sister were the same person. She packed her bags overnight and fled, but before she even left the city gates, she was surrounded by the imperial guards.
Wen Zhuojin looked at the woman she had once bullied into tears, whom she had coaxed into doing many embarrassing things, now approaching her with an aura of fierce menace.
“Ah Zhuo, if you leave, who will be my Empress?”
Just when Wen Zhuojin thought the other would draw a blade on her, Yan Qinglan unexpectedly embraced her and whispered in her ear.
associated_names: 誤把長公主當外室養了
误把长公主当外室养了

102290.synopsis: Reborn as Fang He, a palace maid who boiled water in the tea room of the Qianqing Palace.

104338.synopsis:
*오신(娛神): When a shaman performs a ritual (seance), they sings a song or chant to praise and entertain the gods.
“Since we’re talking about shamans, Shin-oh, make sure to revamp the atmosphere after your inauguration. Distribution isn’t going well, production is a mess, and there are even rumors of ghosts appearing on the filming set.”
Jo Shin-oh, an illegitimate child of the JG Group, paid a high price to be recognized as a biological son. He was almost sacrificed to the family ghost that the family worshipped, and had to handle all sorts of dirty work for years. This included covering up the crimes committed by his older brother, Jo Myungha.
After the death of an actress who had been coerced into providing s*xual favors to Jo Myungha, rumors began spreading that she had appeared as a ghost on the set. Jo Shin-oh visits the set to put the rumor to rest and encounters a man whom Son Gakshi, the vengeful ghost who had been attached to him, wanted.
「I want to eat him. I’ve never drooled like this before. But what to do? I can’t even swallow something like that….」
Son Gakshi promises to release Shin-oh if he helps her latch onto the man she desires. However, her methods are bizarre.
「Do you think I asked you to absorb his yang energy for no reason? If I simply latch onto that terrifying man, I’ll be devoured without a trace. I thought of using you to latch onto him, but you’re just so useless.」
“Explain. Are you really going to latch onto him? Abandoning me? How, how is that even possible?”
「Use your brain. Think about how I latched onto you, and you’ll understand.」
Son Gakshi had attached herself to him because he had betrayed Nam Soyeon. The needles he occasionally found in his clothes were proof of that. He understood that the resentment of being betrayed by the man she loved was what drove her. But…
“You’re saying you’ll attach yourself to him if he betrays me? That’s ridiculous. There’s no betrayal to speak of. We’re nothing to each other.”
「Try it. Make him fall for you and then get him to abandon you. It’s not that difficult, is it?」
Son Gakshi, who’s been around for hundreds of years, was giving him advice like some TV personality. It was absurd.
「Want me to help you if it’s too hard? I can make him so devoted to you that he’ll give you his liver and gall bladder.」
Son Gakshi took out a needle and tried to press it against Shin-oh’s heart. Shin-oh shuddered and pulled his body away.
“Can’t you just get lost?”
「This is the only way. First, develop an emotional attachment. By feeding on his yang energy, He’ll soon find you irresistible.」
Eventually, Shin-oh was tempted by Son Gakshi’s words and proposed sponsorship to Beom Haeyoung.
But the man is no pushover.
“I don’t do prostitution.”
Beom Haeyoung flatly rejected Shin-oh’s proposal outright and continues to build an iron wall.
Shin-oh, driven by an inexplicable impatience, couldn’t help but pursue him.

104594.synopsis: “I Seduced and Abandoned the Heroine’s Older Sister.”

104850.synopsis:
Bai Zhi is an eunuch—a fake eunuch.
In her past life, the empress bestowed upon her a wife, the princess of a fallen kingdom. However, when the crown prince attempted to assault her wife, he was killed in self-defense.
In the end, the fake eunuch and the princess of the fallen kingdom met their fate by being beheaded in public, their lives filled with humiliation and absurdity.
When Bai Zhi opened her eyes again, she found herself reborn one year earlier, when the beautiful and tragic princess of the fallen kingdom had just been tied up and thrown onto her bed.
This time, she only wanted to survive, but as she tried to leave, she was stopped.
The princess, with teary eyes, clutched her sleeve and asked, “Husband, won’t you take me with you?”
Bai Zhi replied, “From now on, I can only live a hard life of farming. You should find your own way.”
Princess: “I am willing to accompany you in a life of men plowing and women weaving.”
Bai Zhi: “…” But I am a woman!

106386.synopsis:
Feared by everyone.
Wanted dead by everyone.
I’ve possessed the body of history’s worst demon lord.
“Pia, come quickly~!”
“…..Yes.”
And this fact.
Is something I’ll have to hide until the day I die.

106898.synopsis:
Bridal coordinator Asaka Takeshi reunites with his very first clients, Mr. and Mrs. Sasagawa, a year after their wedding. The couple had warmly forgiven the mishap Asaka caused on their big day, meeting it with kindness and laughter. Wanting to express his gratitude, he sends them a bouquet for their anniversary…
A tender and bittersweet love story unfolds as a wedding planner and a former client—both straight men—find themselves drawn to each other in unexpected ways.

107154.synopsis:
Xia Feng transmigrated to the Primordial Heaven Continent and became a low-talent good-for-nothing.
Fortunately, he possessed a Dream Pearl, and by accident, he pulled a peerless holy maiden of the Great Xia Empire into his dream. In the dream, they spent a thousand years in love, and with his help, she ascended to godhood.
The next day, after his fiancée publicly broke off their engagement at the betrothal banquet, the peerless holy maiden traveled thousands of miles to find him, shaking the entire continent.
“Husband, this is an Aptitude Pill—it can improve your talent.”
The peerless holy maiden turned into a devoted admirer, showering Xia Feng with endless treasures as if they cost nothing.
His ex-fiancée was dumbfounded, and everyone else was completely stunned.
As Xia Feng’s cultivation level rose step by step, he realized that the Dream Pearl’s abilities were far more powerful than he had imagined.
Low talent and slow cultivation? The Dream Pearl allowed him to live a thousand years in a single dream, and all the cultivation he did in the dream could manifest in the real world.
Just one sleep, and he could master an entire cultivation technique. If one nap could…
associated_names: 退婚后，我被极品圣女们倒追

108178.synopsis: Until the protagonist falls in love with his childhood friend

109714.synopsis:
At the start, Jiang Wan transmigrates into a book as the vicious female supporting character. After being a princess consort for just one day, she’s faced with confiscation of her property and exile?
Jiang Wan sneered coldly and swiftly emptied the enemy’s warehouse.
Her s*umbag father wants to cut ties with her? The prince who harmed her husband is the male lead of the book? The damn emperor won’t even leave her villain husband a way out?
No problem—she takes a walk through the enemy’s warehouse and grabs everything in sight. Jiang Wan’s motto: if even a feather is left behind, she’s lost!
Afraid of starving in the desolate land of exile? She owns a dimensional space filled with stockpiled grain and transforms the barren wilderness into a joyful paradise that everyone envies.
One day, her crippled husband helps a new emperor ascend the throne and is cleared of all charges, returning to the capital in glory. Jiang Wan waves her little handkerchief to bid him farewell.
“Husband, our marriage wasn’t exactly honorable to begin with. I won’t hold you back from finding someone better.”
Go back to the capital? She’d rather stay in this little town and be her own local empress—how sweet is that?
Upon hearing this, Song Jiuyuan tosses aside the imperial decree and pulls her into his arms.
“Wanwan, be good. If you don’t want to go back, then we won’t.”
As for that cursed title of non-royal prince? Whoever wants it can have it!
associated_names: 抄家前，醫妃搬空敵人庫房去逃荒

109970.synopsis:
Lee Jeong-hoon, an ordinary convenience store owner.
After his death, he wakes up in the body of Eddie, an insignificant innkeeper in the novel, “The Hero Doesn’t Hide His Power Too Well.”
“Gerold?”
“Yes.”
“Is this really our inn’s monthly income?”
“Yes.”
All he has is a run-down inn with no customers and a cold but diligent employee. But with his unique positive and proactive personality, Eddie quickly adapts to this new world.
Using the convenience store in the basement that came as a perk of being a possessor, he sets out to turn the failing inn into a hotspot…
Then one day,
“…I am someone who deserves to die.”
He picks up the Hero, who met a tragic end in the original story.
Feeling sorry for him, he feeds him well, clothes him, and gives him a place to sleep…
“Eddie, if you leave me, I don’t know what I’ll do.”
“…”
“So stay by my side.”
At some point, the Hero begins to obsess over him.
associated_names: Even After Being Possessed, I Still Have to Run a Business
Even After Transmigrating, I Still Have to Run a Business

110226.synopsis:
Since childhood, Yuri den Nightwalker had dreamed of a life he no longer lived.
Through these visions, he came to the startling realization that his world was the setting of a novel.
And with that revelation came grim knowledge—of an assassin lurking in the shadows, the looming threat of a demon sword, and, ultimately, the world’s inevitable doom…
associated_names: The bastard with the demon sword remembers his past life

110994.synopsis:
Su Bai, a lawyer with a staggering 99% win rate, suddenly finds himself transported to a parallel world.
Proficient in civil law, criminal law, constitutional law, and administrative law, he’s a master of them all.
Inside the courtroom, facing opposing lawyers and the presiding judge, Su Bai had just one thing to say:
“Let’s handle it according to the law!”
associated_names: 你当律师，把法官送进去了？

112274.synopsis:
【The delicate, frail, gentle and virtuous head madam of the household and the irritable emperor who’ll destroy your whole family at the slightest disagreement swapped bodies.】
Meng Fu, as the wife of the Marquis of Xuanping, managed the household for him, showed filial piety to his parents, and also had to handle the jealous infighting among his concubines in the inner courtyard. She did everything that a marquis’s wife ought to do, only that she never gained the love of her husband.
Meng Fu did not love the Marquis of Xuanping, nor was she heartbroken. She had a premonition that her whole life would pass in still water-like calmness — until one day, when she woke up, someone was calling her “Your Majesty” by her ear.
……
The palace attendants and court officials felt that their Emperor had changed. Before, whenever he opened his mouth, he could scold them until their heads ached; now, he was like a spring breeze—warm and gentle—he would even ask if they were hungry or thirsty.
—I can! I can still work for His Majesty for another hundred years!
The Marquis of Xuanping felt that his wife had changed. Before, she was virtuous, gentle, and generous; now, she was like a firecracker that would explode at the slightest touch. Yesterday, she scolded his most favored concubine into tears; today, she kicked him into the lake.
Inner-courtyard schemes? Laozi will tear your courtyard down!
……
When the Marquis of Xuanping divorced Meng Fu, he declared that this woman would regret it sooner or later. In this capital full of prestigious noble families, who would want a woman who had already been married?
—Zhen wants her.

115858.synopsis:
Shen Ruyi, after unexpectedly transmigrating and being rescued scarred and bruised, only wanted to live a quiet life as a salted fish, eating and waiting to die.
But as she continued to live quietly, how did she become the Miss Ruyi whom everyone respected?
Wangfu Wet Nurse: The desolate patch of land in a corner of the side room is now green with vegetables. It seems this girl wasn’t lying; she’s the daughter of an old farmer.
Client A: The yard-sweeping girl who recently arrived actually knows carpentry. Is it true that in this world, women are used like men and men are used like oxen and horses?
Street Vendor Outside the Gate: Even for a rough maid in the Prince’s Mansion, her accounting is incredibly fast and accurate. Miss, can you teach me?
Advisor B: Who exactly revised that dropped document? It’s making him uneasy about his promotion to advisor in the Prince’s Mansion!
Who is it? Who on earth is it?
She wrote a family letter for a colleague, and the letter was intercepted.
The letter arrived on a certain Prince’s desk. The small, elegant script was flowing, dignified, clear, and graceful, truly the work of a master.
A certain Prince looked up: Is this the “old maid” you claimed could absolutely not be an enemy spy?
Shen Ruyi: …
Clearly, he’s an old man. She even thought the ox was too old, right?
A certain Prince: …
An old ox eating young grass?
Shen Ruyi: …
associated_names: The Uneventful Everyday Life of Ruyi-Guniang

116114.synopsis:
Lu Xueqi had been reincarnated into the world of Qingyun, and to her shock, she had turned from a man into a woman.
Just as Lu Xueqi was about to accept her new life, she realized that something was off about this Qingyun world.
There were actually countless transmigrators in this world, and all of them seemed to have set their sights on her.
As someone who had been a man in her previous life, Lu Xueqi felt deeply uncomfortable with this.
In order to avoid being caught in even more awkward situations in the future,
Lu Xueqi decided to cultivate diligently and vowed never to be weaker than anyone else.
Fortunately, Lu Xueqi had herown exclusive transmigrator cheat—she received the blessing of the Will of the Chaos Universe, awakening a heaven-defying comprehension talent.
associated_names: 青云：悟性逆天，我竟成陆雪琪

117394.synopsis:
A woman transmigrates into a harem novel, becoming one of the male lead’s girlfriends.
Why is the male lead’s girlfriends’ favorability score for me higher than for the male lead himself?
Don’t you all come near me!
From a sadistic and handsome senior, a protective-type yandere, a “gimme” character with housewife attributes, a tsundere young miss, a “gap moe” teacher, an unruly loli, a masochistic and aloof senior, a mature celebrity, an ice-queen doctor, a younger cousin with a sister complex, a “green tea” child star, to a femme fatale—Liang Sheng constantly finds herself trapped in a “shuraba” as the girls fight over her out of jealousy.
This is the story of a “pseudo-straight” girl being pursued by twelve other girls.
associated_names: 穿越后的我把男主女友们全掰弯了

132754.synopsis:
Transmigrated into an open-world game, she became an immortal witch and a witness to the splendor of the age of swords and magic.
Good news: The game was one she had helped create.
Bad news: The timeline doesn’t match, and the plot feels a bit off.
Having lost all her advantages, she opts for the Japanese-style approach—lay low for a while, hide out in the countryside to slowly grow stronger, farm, brew potions, and forge weapons.
As for venturing outside… that can wait.
associated_names: 嗯？播种不是在魔女身上进行的！

140434.synopsis:
The life of 26-year-old Jung Seonwoo is extremely ordinary. To be precise, it ‘was’ ordinary.
“…No, there’s no way, right?”
「Why is there no way?」
“Aaaargh——!”
Until he suddenly encountered a ghost, and was tormented by them ever since.
Church was no use, and temples were no use. Shamans… seemed even more useless.
It was a time when he wondered if he would be tormented by ghosts for the rest of his life.
[Spirit Possession (50,000 won), Sleep Paralysis (50,000 won), Haunted House Aftereffects (100,000 won), Moved to the Wrong House (80,000 won), Picked Up an Object (80,000 won), Just Seeing Things (30,000 won)] 
It was in a shabby alley that he encountered a vending machine with a list of bizarre menu items. Seonwoo, feeling like he was grasping at straws, paid the (hefty sum of) 30,000 won and—
“Are you coming in?”
“C-can I come in?”
“Come if you’re coming.”
—he meets a man even more bizarre, one with an extraordinary aura flowing around him.

140690.synopsis:
In Haishi, there’s a common saying: Tan Dashao’s (Young Master Tan’s) arrogance, three parts are the Tan family’s fault, seven parts are Shen Zongnian’s.
Tan Youming had long held the title of the island’s most coveted playboy. TCB magazine once famously wrote, “When Mr. Tan smiles, even a typhoon over the island seems to clear.”
But a dazzling butterfly is impossible to catch.
No one knows that the amount of money Tan Youming has spent on Shen Zongnian is a thousand, ten thousand times more than all the gifts he’s ever given to his female companions, female friends, or blind dates combined.
When a date invited him to dinner, Tan Youming glanced at his watch and said, “Next time. Shen Zongnian’s about to get off work.”
“……”
At an auction, when a date said she wanted a painting, Tan Youming smiled and said, “That one’s no good. My friend likes it.” He added, gentlemanly, “Why don’t you pick another?”
“……”
Shen Zongnian, cast out by his own family, was sent to the Tan household at twelve, where he lived under their protection until he came of age. With iron-willed determination, he clawed his way to the top in just a few short years—stepping over the bones of kin, sparing no one: the parents who abandoned him, the cousin who framed him, the uncles who threatened him, and anyone who took advantage of him when he was down.
But now, he’s decided to release the butterfly that was never his to keep.
associated_names: The Sea Breeze Knows My Heart

142226.synopsis:
【Campus】【Slice of Life】【Comedy】【Romance】【Lighthearted】【Ensemble Cast】【No Toxicity】【Non-Supernatural】
【Prologue: The Beginning of It All – Use holy water to heal the saintess tainted by demonic energy, then converse with her.】
Shen Nian stared at his older sister sipping yogurt, lost in thought.
So you’re telling me my sister is the saintess, and yogurt is the holy water?
【Main Quest 1: Brave Youth, Become an Adventurer! Reward: Rookie Adventurer Title.】
【Side Quest 1: Find the Adorable Kitty! Reward: 1000 Gold Coins.】
Shen Nian: “Wait, I’m a high school senior here—did some guy who got isekai’d accidentally bind his system to me?”
Hold on, completing quests gives gold rewards?
Titles even boost stats?
